With a catalogue of nutritious recipes that suit any diet, the app will introduce you to a balanced approach to health and fitness that will leave you feeling your best.

Whether you are looking to start your fitness journey or searching for a new challenge, the Madfit App’s broad selection of workouts and workout programs that range from beginner to expert, will help you form healthy habits and build your strength.

All members will get exclusive access to the following features:

A Personal Trainer At Your Finger Tips:
• Renowned Fitness Trainer Maddie Lymburner will guide you through your daily workouts providing you with direction on form, inspiration to push your physical limits, and the knowledge essential to improving your mental and physical strength.

Recipe Section
• Get inspired to spend more time creating nutritious meals with the all-new recipe section. Choose from a catalogue of delicious and nutritious breakfast, mains, snack, and dessert recipes. Filter through them based on your diet type, or diet preferences. With new recipes added regularly, you will never get bored of making the same meal twice!

Real-Time Workouts
• Follow along to real-time workouts! Choose from a variety of workouts varying in length and difficulty level, all guided by Maddie. Work towards achievement badges in the activity tab, engage with other MadFit users in the comments of each video, and save your favourites by liking the video so you can easily find them each time you open the app!

Real-Time Programs
• Having trouble trying to figure out where to start? Subscribe to a program or challenge in the new real-time programs section! These programs and challenges are comprised of follow along workout videos put together in a to get you into the habit of exercising daily.

Classic Programs
• Choose between Maddie’s 4-week Beginner, 8-week Dancer Sculpt and 12-week Full Body programs which are designed to tone your muscles, build your stamina and improve your fitness. Each day of the program will target new muscles and push your body to new lengths. These programs feature visual and audio guides to ensure you are performing all exercises correctly.

Add Photos and Track your Progress
• Add your progress photos to keep track of the progress you’ve made with the MadFit App. Share your photos with the community and motivate others to reach their goals!

Sync with Apple Music, Health and more
• Sync with Apple music to listen to your favourite songs while exercising. MadFit uses HealthKit to export your activities into the health app to read your heart rate and biometric data to better track your fitness progress. The MadFit App will also sync with your calendar and Siri.

Join our Community
• Tap the community button inside the app and join the exclusive MadFit Insider community. Get the latest information, ask questions and get inspired by different community members around the world who are using the MadFit App!
